section_title: Examples of predicate crimes > Drug trafficking

propositions.proposition: 在毒品贩卖活动中，洗钱可能发生在采购、制造或分销阶段。
source_quotes: Money laundering can occur during the sourcing, manufacturing, or distribution stages.

propositions.proposition: 犯罪组织利用国际贸易体系清洗毒品收益，例如通过哥伦比亚黑市比索兑换系统转换货币，以掩盖资金来源。
source_quotes: criminal organizations also utilize the international trade system to launder proceeds from drug trafficking
Colombian drug traffickers ... have historically used the Colombian Black Market Peso Exchange (BMPE) to convert US dollars into Colombian pesos ... obscuring the origins of their funds.

propositions.proposition: 毒品贩卖所得被视为脏钱，必须隐藏以避免执法部门侦查。
source_quotes: the proceeds are considered 'dirty money' that need to be concealed to avoid detection by law enforcement.

propositions.proposition: 部分毒品的合法医疗用途使得执法和监管工作复杂化。
source_quotes: The legal status of some of these drugs complicates enforcement and regulation efforts.
